# SiliconScale Tech

> SiliconScale Tech is a software development agency specializing in AI solutions, custom web applications, Shopify development, and scalable backend systems for startups and growing businesses.

## Services

- [Custom Software Development](https://siliconscale.dev/services): Internal tools, dashboards, customer platforms, and automation replacing manual workflows.
- [AI Solutions](https://siliconscale.dev/services): AI agents and automation that handle repetitive business tasks.
- [Shopify Development](https://siliconscale.dev/services): Headless Shopify storefronts with custom frontends, checkout, and migrations.
- [API Development](https://siliconscale.dev/services): Backend APIs and integrations connecting business systems and third-party services.

## Portfolio

- [Our Work](https://siliconscale.dev/work): Case studies with measurable outcomes across fashion-tech, e-commerce, and research platforms.

## Blog

- [Engineering Articles](https://siliconscale.dev/blog): Practical notes on systems, Shopify builds, and AI agents.

## Company

- [About](https://siliconscale.dev/about): Mission, principles, and how the remote India-based team works.
- [Contact](https://siliconscale.dev/contact): Project inquiry form with budget, timeline, and scope details.

## Sitemap

- [XML Sitemap](https://siliconscale.dev/sitemap.xml): Complete machine-readable index of all pages and blog posts.
